_meta.what: Landing-error grid around each team site: terrain horizon at every grid point
_meta.horizon: 720 values, azimuth 0..359.5 every 0.5 deg from local north clockwise, in HUNDREDTHS of a degree (divide by 100)
_meta.method: Same as horizons.json for team sites: LOLA 5 m (PGDA 78) near field + LOLA 80 m (PGDA 90) to 150 km, observer 2 m
_meta.slope: slope100: deg over a 100 m baseline (NASA Artemis III landing criterion: <10 deg over 100 m), from the 5 m DEM. slope10: same over 10 m (finer, noisier)
_meta.grid: 11x11 every 40 m, points within 200 m of the site
